Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive) ♦ Install: Clinic

Humanity Loss: 7 (2d6)

By re-routing chipware data through a cranial-mounted drive, it can be parsed twice as efficiently A favorite of top-notch BD editors.

Neuralware. When a Skill Chip for an INT or TECH related Skill is first installed into one of the user’s Shard Slots or Chipware Sockets, they may choose to link it to their MRAM Drive. While the Skill Chip is linked, instead of setting its respective Skill to Level 3, it instead provides a +3 bonus to the Skill, to a maximum Skill Total of 6 (Skill Level + Bonuses). Only one MRAM Drive can be installed.

NOTE: Credit to Disdraft from the From the Ashes LC for the inspiration behind this item.

Type: Neuralware
Install: Clinic
Option Slots: uses 1

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Neuralware).
